chunks: “Modesty consists of ten parts: nine are in women and one is in men. When a woman undergoes circumcision, one part of her modesty goes; when she marries, one part goes; when her virginity is taken, one part goes; and when she gives birth, one part goes, leaving five parts for her. Then if she commits adultery, all of her modesty goes; but if she remains chaste, five parts remain for her.”

key_terms.أَجْزَاءٍ: parts or portions; degrees into which modesty is divided
key_terms.اَلرِّجَالِ: men; contrasted with women in the distribution mentioned
key_terms.اَلنِّسَاءِ: women; the primary subject discussed in the hadith
key_terms.اَلْحَيَاءُ: modesty; the moral quality of shame and reserve
key_terms.خَمْسَةُ أَجْزَاءٍ: five parts; the remaining share of modesty mentioned in the narration
key_terms.عَفَّتْ: she remained chaste; preserving sexual purity
key_terms.فَجَرَتْ: she committed sexual immorality; the act said to remove modesty

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about modesty, women, and chastity?
ai.summary: This hadith presents modesty as a moral quality divided into degrees and speaks about its preservation in relation to women's life stages and chastity. Its central ethical emphasis is that chastity preserves modesty, while sexual immorality destroys it.
